title: Change log
html:
Date What changed
2 Oct 2026 First version: notes organized video by video for Ng's week 1 and two overview videos.
8 Oct 2026 Week 2 added, still video by video: StatQuest, Infinite Codes on maths, two agent videos, Ng's lessons 5 to 7.
12 Oct 2026 Rewritten as a textbook of 18 chapters organized by topic, with figures, tested code, loan examples, review questions, a formula sheet and a reading list. The week 1 and 2 notes were folded into chapters 1 to 8 and 13 to 17. Chapters 9 to 11 (week 3 videos) and 18 (RAG) were written ahead of the videos, and chapter 12 comes from standard sources.
17 Oct 2026 Week 4 videos added to the Video index (rows 14 to 21, status Next): confusion matrix, sensitivity and specificity, ROC and AUC, cross-validation, three neural network videos and decision trees. Chapters 12, 13 and 14 already exist and will be revised after you watch them; chapter 13 gets a Gini impurity example.
